category_title: Preschoolers who throw tantrums during cleanup transitions
student_description: Olivia is a creative preschooler who enjoys dramatic play but struggles severely with transitions, particularly cleaning up. When prompted abruptly to clean up, she throws severe tantrums by dropping to the floor and screaming. She uniquely requires advance warnings and structured transition supports to process the end of playtime, as well as explicit long-term instruction in emotional regulation.

criteria.rationale: Olivia's severe tantrums are triggered by abrupt clean-up demands, so she requires a clear warning before playtime actually ends to mentally prepare.
criteria.check: The tutor provides a verbal or visual warning that playtime will be ending soon, rather than demanding immediate clean-up.

criteria.rationale: Concrete cues help Olivia process the shift from dramatic play to cleaning up without becoming overwhelmed.
criteria.check: The tutor incorporates a transition aid, such as a visual support, a choice board, or a first/then framing, to guide the clean-up process.
